neighbours.label: a percentage or share of money taken off a price or given away from sales/proceeds ('15% off', '5% of all sales', 'a portion of the proceeds')
fire: Subscribe today and receive 20% off your next purchase.
The bakery gives 2% of its profits to the local animal shelter.
Students get a 15% discount on all books in the store.
A share of the proceeds from the concert will go to flood victims.
Use the code SPRING to save 25% on all garden tools.
The company pledges 1% of every sale to ocean cleanup projects.
Twenty percent of all ticket sales will be donated to the school.
Loyalty members enjoy 10% off every order over fifty dollars.
quiet: By noon the relative humidity had climbed to 90%.
Inflation fell to 3% in the last quarter of the year.
About 70% of the voters turned out for the election.
The battery was at 40% when I left the house.
Nearly half of the population lives in the capital.
The test has an accuracy of 95% in clinical trials.
Twenty percent of the land is covered by forest.
The stock price dropped 8% after the report.
